title: Domination and packing in graphs
summary: The dominating number $γ(G)$ of a graph $G$ is the minimum size of a vertex set whose closed neighborhoods cover all vertices of $G$, while the packing number $ρ(G)$ is the maximum size of a vertex set whose closed neighborhoods are pairwise disjoint. In this paper we investigate graph classes $\mathcal{G}$ for which the ratio $γ(G)/ρ(G)$ is bounded by a constant $c_{\mathcal{G}}$ for every $G \in \mathcal{G}$.
